naming.class_type: mutable struct named after the wx class, e.g. wxFrame
naming.constant: zero-argument function named without the wx prefix, e.g. ID_ANY()
naming.constructor: class name called as a function, e.g. wxFrame(parent, id, text, left, top, width, height, style)
naming.method: snake_case function taking the object as its first argument, with a trailing ! for a void method, e.g. set_title!(obj, text)
naming.module: KwxFFI for the raw ccall layer, plus one generated file per class for the idiomatic layer

events.handler_type: Function taking one wxEvent argument, wrapped in a @cfunction closure
